description: Told where Story Phase 10 starts (Pete, at the crater), once.
Story Phase 10 has begun: the Crimson Clearing is a crater, the Crimson Fortune is in the Great Sharkstorm, and Pete would like it noted that none of it was his fault.
The captain told Pete none of it was his fault. He's angry with the sharks, and with the Grand Stenchmaster.
'I used to be Blackbeard.' Squawks: 'Now Stinkbeard.' A breathing exercise through the beard: IT STILL STINKS. Root-deep.

Story Phase 10: chapter 93 has begun.
The Great Sharkstorm has the Revenge: inside, going round.
The Queen Anne's Revenge is inside the Great Sharkstorm.
The Grand Stenchmaster is no longer charged. He feels fantastic.
Rusty Tom and Barnacle Bill have hold of the sash.
Inside the storm the Mark II lost its picture (aerial knocked flat).
Chapter 93: a picture on the Mark II (the sauce-can aerial).
The Mark II's aerial is now a can of Spicy Stench Sauce. It works.
Story Phase 10: chapter 94 has begun.
Chapter 94: watched the impossible audit.
The Frog Tax Man audited the Great Sharkstorm, live, while the Revenge was inside it. Unexplained.
The Frog Tax Man broadcast can't have happened. It did. Nobody explains it.
The Bling Bling King was on television, and SPOKE (smooth). In person it never has.
The 'Ancient Stenchmaster Transfer Doctrine' (Fart It, Lose It; Chapter 47): made up. Garrick: 'That's made up!'
Franklin taxed the Bling Bling King; it paid with one of the captain's crowns.
Bling Bling King Treasure Solutions: an advertisement.
Story Phase 10: chapter 95 has begun.
'I used to be Blackbeard.' A breath through the beard. It's still in there. Root-deep.
Story Phase 10 is complete: the Queen Anne's Revenge is INSIDE the Great Sharkstorm, still trapped, going round. Not resolved.
Story Phase 10: chapter 78 has begun.
Chapter 78: saw what went off in the hold.
A vat of Spicy Stench Sauce vented in the hold: the barracks are uninhabitable this phase.
Chapter 78: where everyone sleeps, decided.
Rusty Tom: deckhand since Portsmouth, first to volunteer, sorry every time.
Barnacle Bill: an old deckhand. NOT Barnacle Bob. Not related.
Chapter 78: the boards off the old quarters' door, for the test.
Rusty Tom checked the old quarters: still condemned. 'That release moved in.' Never sleepable.
Rusty Tom's quarters test happened (once).
